premises: Sluggish diffusion in HEAs kinetically stabilizes the solid solution against phase separation during annealing.
Rapid thermal quenching (e.g., thermal shock) can preserve a homogeneous alloy state by limiting diffusion time.
PtPdCoCuNi HEA nanoparticles can be synthesized as a homogeneous solid solution.
Oxidizing conditions promote selective oxidation of less noble metals, driving surface segregation.
Prolonged isothermal heating enhances atomic mobility, leading to phase decomposition.
